pipeline: L1: MOMENTUM screener (live, RSI>60 + Mom 1W>0 + Price>EMA50 1M) → L2: LuxAlgo 3 screeners on 1W (hard filter: BOS + Bullish/Strong Bullish S&O Rating + ▲/▲+ Signal) → L3: NW Envelope per-symbol check (price inside bands = room to run, price above upper band = extended/wait)

nw_position_rules.inside: Room to run — valid entry candidate if R:R ≥ 1.5
nw_position_rules.extended: Price above NW upper band — do not enter, wait for weekly pullback to inside bands
nw_position_rules.below_lower: Price below NW lower band — avoid, trend may be broken

long: Symbol passed L2 hard filter (lux_screener_scan output: score ≥ 0)
NW position = inside (price between lower and upper band)
R:R ≥ 1.5: reward = NW upper band minus current price, risk = current price minus NW lower band

exit_criteria.stop_loss: NW Envelope lower band on the weekly
exit_criteria.take_profit_1: Scale out 1/3 when price touches NW upper band
exit_criteria.take_profit_2: Trail remaining via weekly 9 EMA — exit if closes below for 2 consecutive weeks

risk_rules: Do not enter if NW position = extended
asset_notes: Momentum stocks — weekly timeframe. Symbols flow through: MOMENTUM screener (live) → lux_screener_scan 1W (BOS + Bullish + ▲ hard filter in scoreSymbol) → NW Envelope check (inside/extended/below_lower). Only NW Envelope is read per-symbol on the chart. LuxAlgo 3 screeners run on the LUXALGO_SCREENERS chart tab, not the per-symbol chart.
